semantic_checks: Before timing and after each seven-sample batch entry, validate the held exact result against independent num::BigRational; the Python collector checks each emitted exact row against Fraction. The three separate retention tests check exact arithmetic and source lifetimes.
timed_loops: Each iteration executes and black-boxes the result; there is no costly numerator/denominator conversion or equality assertion inside each timed iteration. Total measured query count is not a count of individually asserted exact values.
required_reporting: State measured calls and separately counted validated output rows. Batch maxima are tail proxies, not individual-query percentiles. Original Nano output statistics do not independently establish full geometry equivalence or its all-board golden artifact.
